rationale: C07 is a highly plausible immediate drafting template: it was issued three days before the child by the same President, uses nearly identical recitals and the same complete sequence of operative provisions, and differs chiefly by substituting the steel dispute for the maritime dispute and changing the reporting deadline. C19 and C10 share the same statutory machinery and substantial language, but C07 is closest in wording, structure, timing, and drafting conventions.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS such dispute has resulted in a strike which, in my opinion, affects a substantial part of the steel industry, an industry engaged in trade, commerce, and transportation among the several States and with foreign nations, and in the production of goods for commerce, and which strike will, if permitted to continue, imperil the national health and safety
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS such disputes have resulted in a strike which, in my opinion, affects a substantial part of the maritime industry, an industry engaged in trade, commerce, transportation, transmission, or communication among the several states and with foreign nations, and which strike will, if permitted to continue, imperil the national health and safety
shared_material.explanation: The child closely reproduces C07's distinctive sentence construction and sequence, adapting the industry description and deleting the maritime-specific consequences.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Board shall have powers and duties as set forth in Title II of such Act. The Board shall report to the President in accordance with the provisions of section 206 of such Act on or before October 16, 1959.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Board shall have powers and duties as set forth in Title II of such Act. The Board shall report to the President in accordance with the provisions of Section 206 of such Act on or before October 10, 1959.
shared_material.explanation: The operative provision is essentially identical apart from capitalization and the dispute-specific deadline.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Upon submission of its report, the Board shall continue in existence to perform such other functions as may be required under such Act, until the Board is terminated by the President.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Upon the submission of its report, the Board shall continue in existence to perform such other functions as may be required under such Act, until the Board is terminated by the President.
shared_material.explanation: The continuation-and-termination clause is reproduced virtually verbatim, completing the same operative sequence.
